rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a general distrustful attitude, without necessarily implying a full cynical worldview.

example.english: I have some cynicism toward strangers.
example.traditional: 我對陌生人有啲唔信任。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 mak6 saang1 jan4 jau5 di1 m4 seon3 jam6

rows.note: Use this for a scornfully pessimistic remark or act rather than for an underlying attitude.

example.english: Saying that pay raises are just a rumour was cynicism.
example.traditional: 佢話加人工只係傳聞，根本係冷嘲熱諷。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 gaa1 jan4 gung1 zi2 hai6 cyun4 man4 gan1 bun2 hai6 laang5 zaau1 jit6 fung3

rows.note: Use this for a developed cynical worldview that assumes other people are driven by hidden self-interest.

example.english: This political outlook is full of cynicism, assuming everyone acts only for personal gain.
example.traditional: 呢套政見充滿犬儒主義，認定人人做事都係為咗自己。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 zing3 gin3 cung1 mun5 hyun2 jyu4 zyu2 ji6 jing6 ding6 jan4 jan4 zou6 si6 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 zi6 gei2
